meta.note: Landing palette and type (docs/index.html). v2 scope: landing tokens for new pages; page-specific palettes listed as Drift in README.md.

tokens.name: page-bg

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Butter pat mark (a shape, not text). As text on header-bg #6B4F10 it is 5.59 to 1. Eyebrow text uses eyebrow-text, not this token. docs/index.html:35, docs/index.html:127

tokens.name: eyebrow-text

tokens.name: wordmark

tokens.name: nav-link
